official_task_documentation.description: There are several objects on the table and a box. The robot needs to pick up all the objects, place them into the box, and ensure that each object is oriented with its front side facing left.

scoring.condition: No object is placed correctly into the box.
Any one object is inside the box with its front side facing left, the box is aligned, and the gripper is open.
Any two objects are placed correctly into the box.
Any three objects are placed correctly into the box.
All four objects are placed in the aligned box with correct facing direction, and the robot returns to origin.
